entries.1d2b58dc1a8806bf: A manufacturer that makes tires for passenger cars and trucks, among others, and anti-vibration rubber for automobiles, and sells them around the world.
entries.23b4f9431083ea68: This business manufactures and sells anti-vibration rubber for automobiles and other products.
entries.3bf3055297d83584: This business manufactures and sells tires and related products for passenger cars, light trucks, and trucks and buses. In Japan, Tōyō Taiya Japan Co., Ltd. sells the products, and Fukushima Gomu Co., Ltd. and others manufacture them. Overseas, Toyo Tire U.S.A. Corp., Nitto Tire U.S.A. Inc. and others sell the products, and Toyo Tire North America Manufacturing Inc. (United States), Toyo Tyre Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. and Toyo Tire Serbia d.o.o. manufacture them. External customer sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥547,697 million (¥519,832 million in the previous year), a 5.4% increase year on year. The company cites firm sales volumes of priority products in North America and the spread of price increases, as well as the effect of price increases in Japan and for new-vehicle tires. It states that sales volume and sales revenue in Europe both fell significantly below the previous year due to operational changes accompanying business restructuring.
entries.6082a1f1ebc9d363: The company sells new-vehicle tires and automotive parts to automakers, and sells replacement tires to domestic and overseas markets through sales companies. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, of revenue by customer location, sales to North America were ¥363,753 million, the largest, and sales to Japan were ¥111,476 million. Sales to American Tire Distributors, Inc. were ¥63,672 million, or 10.7% of consolidated revenue.
entries.6458b8bd2632193f: It consists of the company, 33 subsidiaries and 9 affiliates, and mainly engages in the Tire Business and the Automotive Parts Business, and also handles the supply and maintenance of equipment and molds, and fund procurement and management.

entries.91b214394d6c5eec: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥594,923 million (up 5.2% year on year), of which the Tire Business was ¥547,697 million and the Automotive Parts Business was ¥47,225 million. The company states that solid sales volumes of priority products in North America and the pass-through of price increases raised revenue.
entries.9242730cb57c75f8: It manufactures tires for passenger cars, light trucks, and trucks and buses and related products, and automotive parts such as automotive anti-vibration rubber.
entries.a584e20a66b27119: This business manufactures and sells anti-vibration rubber for automobiles and other products. In Japan, Tōyō Gomu Kakōhin Co., Ltd. and Ayabe Tōyō Gomu Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell the products; overseas, Toyo Tire North America OE Sales LLC sells them, and Toyo Zoso (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells them. External customer sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥47,225 million (¥45,526 million in the previous year), a 3.7% increase year on year. The company states that sales rose above the previous year because demand from automakers remained stable.
entries.d4eed318ded22d5a: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥63,614 million (down 15.0% year on year). The company states that it recorded a gain on sale of investment securities and impairment losses.
entries.d6e6d139593c51c6: It is a company that makes tires and automotive anti-vibration rubber and sells them worldwide, centered on North America.
entries.e4e2e0ef4d85c3ed: Automotive parts, including anti-vibration rubber for automobiles and others
entries.fa7941bc2db1c0e0: The company states that its five-year Medium-Term Management Plan 'Chukei '21' ended in 2025 and that it had broadly achieved the management indicators it set. Going forward, it will advance business reform and productivity improvement using DX and AI, and, with the five-year Medium-Term Management Plan 'Chukei '26', starting from 2026, as its core, it intends to maintain a high-profit structure.
